summary: Frontend testing of Backup Command Center merge completed successfully. All 9 tabs visible (Dashboard, Live, Tenants, Backup Status, Acronis Console, Orphans, Compliance, Billing, Verify). Tenants tab shows 83 real Acronis tenants (Bindiwalla Pastoral, Allwright Bourke, Cameron Rosser, etc.). Backup Status tab shows 364 real machines with Run buttons. Billing tab shows pricing config, currency selector, and billing preview. Dashboard shows real Acronis data (forbesservicesclub, midpro, etc.) NOT mock data. Sidebar shows 'Backup Command Center' as top-level item with no 'Acronis Tenants & Billing' sub-item. Old route /backup-dashboard correctly loads the merged page.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor ESLint warnings in BackupStatusTab.jsx, BillingTab.jsx, TenantsTab.jsx about missing useEffect dependencies - not blocking but should be addressed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup Command Center merge is complete. All 9 tabs working with real Acronis data. Old route /backup-dashboard redirects correctly. No mock data present.
